svg.title: Mini Map Macau architecture
svg.desc: External sources are normalised into JSON, loaded through static assets and schedule-specific API requests, and replayed on a simulated clock; the DSAT car-park vacancy API provides live updates while the clock is at the present.
svg.text: upstream → pipeline → JSON & APIs → simulated clock in the browser
